description.value: Kam Wai Dim Sum is a family-run dim sum shop that has been a fixture of Vancouver's Chinatown since 1991, specializing in both frozen take-home dim sum classics and ready-to-eat takeaway items. The menu spans pork siu mai, wonton soup, BBQ pork bao, and vegan mushroom dumplings, with staff serving customers in English, Mandarin, and Cantonese. A second location (Kam Wai Legacy) now operates in the Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood at 2285 E Hastings St.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Kam Wai Dim Sum is an active, family-run dim sum shop at 249 E Pender St in Vancouver's Chinatown, corroborating the OSM phone number and address. The website explicitly lists 'Ready-To-Eat takeaway favourites' and individual items described as 'Ready-to-Eat', confirming takeout; it also lists 'Vegan Mushroom Dumplings' as a menu item, confirming a vegan option. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag ('Mo-Su 09:00-18:00') does not match the website, which shows the Chinatown location is closed on Mondays and has varying close times (4:00 PM Tue–Thu, 6:00 PM Fri–Sun). OSM hours should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible takeaway dim sum shop in Vancouver's Chinatown with a confirmed website and matching contact details. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking ready-to-eat food.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business operates a second location, Kam Wai Legacy, at 2285 E Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5L 1V3, which is not represented in this OSM record and may warrant a separate listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists 'Vegan Mushroom Dumplings' (素三菇餃) explicitly as a menu item available frozen or ready-to-eat
